notablePrerequisites: Gyre Sage does not have summoning sickness, and has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat.
